combo.description: Press your R then instantly Flash to hit your Ultimate. Then use your W followed by your E and then Q and E some more to finish.
Start with a Q then E and E again. Use your W then E then hit them with your R before another E Q and E again to finish them off.
Lead with your R into your W then E & E. Use your Q then E some more to finish the job!
Lead with your Q, then E and E again before using your W. Now you can E some more before another Q and E to finish.
Land your Q, then E as many times as you can before your Q comes back up before using it again!
